# VaneTools Directory — open MCP catalog & docs

> Open catalog behind the VaneTools AI directory (38,182 curated AI resources) and the
> documentation for its public MCP endpoint at https://vanetools.com/mcp.
> Read-only, no authentication. Catalog data is MIT licensed.

The main site lives at https://vanetools.com (bilingual EN/中文). This GitHub Pages
site documents the MCP endpoint and hosts the open catalog snapshot.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://richardxu001.github.io/vanetools-directory/): what the MCP server exposes, connection summary, catalog stats.
- [Connection guide](https://richardxu001.github.io/vanetools-directory/connect/): copy-paste configs for Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code.
- [Catalog](https://richardxu001.github.io/vanetools-directory/tools/): type-by-type breakdown and the machine-readable index.
- [FAQ](https://richardxu001.github.io/vanetools-directory/faq/): pricing, auth, data source, refresh cadence, licensing.

## Data

- Catalog JSON (MIT): https://github.com/RichardXu001/vanetools-directory/blob/main/tools/catalog.json
- Registry manifest: https://github.com/RichardXu001/vanetools-directory/blob/main/server.json
- Full resource feed: https://vanetools.com/llms-full.txt
